title: 第二十三章 古有霸王举鼎第二十章 祖师爷赏饭也得看命
slug: 民国戏子请叫我武道宗师
content_zh:
“我的车，脏了。”
陆诚看着那辆被踩脏的洋车，淡淡说了一句。
下一秒。
他动了。
“嗡！”
手中的白蜡大枪猛地一抖。
那根柔韧的枪杆子，在明劲的灌注下，瞬间崩成了一条直线。
面对冲在最前面的那个拿砍刀的汉子。
陆诚直接把枪杆子当鞭子使。
拦、拿、扎！
“啪！”
一声脆响。
那白蜡杆子狠狠地抽在那汉子的手腕上。
喀嚓！
骨头碎裂的声音清晰可闻。
那汉子惨叫一声，手里的砍刀飞出去了老远。
但这只是开始。
陆诚身形如龙，冲进了人群。
这一刻，他不再是那个温文尔雅的角儿。
他是杀神！

白蜡大枪在他手中，化作了漫天白影。
他没有用枪尖去扎人的要害，那是杀人，会惹上官司。
他用的是“抽”、“挑”、“拨”、“崩”！
“啪，啪，啪！”
枪杆抽在皮肉上的声音，不绝于耳。
每一枪下去，必有一人倒地。
或是被抽断了胳膊，或是被扫断了小腿，或是被枪杆崩在胸口，直接背过气去。
就在这时，侧面一道黑影大吼着冲了过来，手里举着根哨棒，闭着眼睛就要往下砸。
但这人的动作明显慢了半拍，而且透着股子犹豫，没什么杀气。
陆诚手中的大枪本能地就要一记“崩”字诀，这一枪要是崩实了，这人的肋骨至少得断三根。
但在枪杆即将接触到那人胸口的瞬间，陆诚看清了那张脸。
冻得通红的脸，破棉袄。
是栓子。
那个前两天还帮父亲抬车，眼神清亮，说只想给老娘抓药的憨厚后生。
此刻，栓子的眼里满是惊恐，那是被生活逼到了墙角，不得不咬人的狗的眼神。
陆诚眉头一皱，手腕猛地一翻。
“卸”字诀！
原本刚猛无铸的崩劲瞬间化作了柔劲。
枪杆没有砸断他的骨头，而是像教书先生的戒尺一样，“啪”地一声，狠狠抽在了栓子举着棍子的手背上。
“当啷！”

哨棒落地。
栓子疼得一激灵，睁开眼，正对上陆诚那双冰冷的眸子。
他吓得双腿一软，直接跪在了泥地里“陆、陆爷……”
陆诚的大枪悬在他头顶，没有落下，大枪一抖，换了个方向，再次杀入人群。
content_en:
"My car is dirty."
Lu Cheng looked at the trampled foreign car and said lightly.
The next second.
He moved.
"Buzz!"
The big white wax gun in his hand shook violently.
The flexible gun barrel instantly collapsed into a straight line under the infusion of Ming Jin.
Facing the man with the machete who rushed to the front.
Lu Cheng directly used the gun barrel as a whip.
Block, take, stab!
"Crack!"
There was a crisp sound.
The white wax rod hit the man's wrist hard.
Click!
The sound of bones breaking was clearly audible.
The man screamed and the machete in his hand flew far away.
But this is just the beginning.
Lu Cheng, shaped like a dragon, rushed into the crowd.
At this moment, he was no longer the gentle and elegant character.
He is the god of death!
In his hand, the big white wax gun turned into white shadows all over the sky.
He did not use the tip of the spear to stab someone's vitals. That would be murder and would lead to a lawsuit.
He uses "pump", "pick", "dial" and "collapse"!
"Pah, pah, pah!"
The sound of the gun barrel hitting the flesh was endless.
Every time a shot is fired, one person will fall to the ground.
Either the arm was cut off, or the calf was swept off, or the gun barrel was smashed into the chest, and the breath was taken away.
At this moment, a black figure from the side rushed over with a roar, holding a whistle stick in his hand, and was about to smash it down with his eyes closed.
But this man's movements were obviously half a beat slower, and he showed hesitation, without any murderous intent.
The big gun in Lu Cheng's hand instinctively hit the word "collapse". If the gun collapsed, at least three of the man's ribs would be broken.
But the moment the gun barrel was about to touch the man's chest, Lu Cheng saw the face clearly.
His face was red from the cold, and his cotton-padded jacket was torn.
It's a bolt.
The honest young man who helped his father carry the car two days ago, with clear eyes, said he just wanted to give me medicine.
At this moment, Shuanzi's eyes were full of fear. They were the eyes of a dog who was forced into a corner by life and had to bite people.
Lu Cheng frowned and flicked his wrist.
The word "unload"!
The strength that was originally strong and unyielding instantly turned into a soft strength.
The barrel of the gun did not break his bones, but like a teacher's ruler, it struck the back of Shuan Zi's hand holding the stick with a "snap" sound.
"Clang!"
The whistle stick landed.
Shuanzi throbbed in pain, opened his eyes, and met Lu Cheng's cold eyes.
He was so frightened that his legs weakened and he knelt directly in the mud. "Lu, Master Lu..."
Lu Cheng's big gun hung above his head without falling. The big gun shook, changed direction, and charged into the crowd again.
